caseNameFull: Jefferson County, Alabama v. Acker, Senior Judge, United States District Court, Northern District of Alabama

opinions.text: C. A. 11th Cir. Certiorari granted limited to the following questions: “1. Whether the District Court had subject matter jurisdiction over this action in light of the Tax Injunction Act, 28 U. S. C. § 1341? 2. Whether a county privilege/ occupational tax levied upon the pay or compensation of an Article *1040Ill judge violates the Supremacy Clause?”
